findings.current: With the Fire Gate Sect Leader’s arrival, the tide turned sharply.
findings.defect: The leader’s title changes the established Fire Gate Clan to a sect within the same account.
findings.rationale: The surrounding narration identifies the organization as the Fire Gate Clan.
findings.replacement: With the leader of the Fire Gate Clan’s arrival, the tide turned sharply.
findings.source: Chapter 850, Namho’s account of the Five Poisons Sect war

findings.current: We had a little over fifteen days left. We had to hurry, even if it was only by a single hour.
findings.defect: The time remaining contradicts Namho’s statement moments earlier that there are fewer than fifteen days until the first of the month.
findings.rationale: Both lines count down to the same arrival date; the final narration should agree with the deadline just given.
findings.replacement: We had fewer than fifteen days left. We had to hurry, even if it was only by a single hour.

findings.current: Jin and his party have departed to intercept Prince Shangshan in Jiangsu before the first of next month.
findings.defect: The state places an interception in Jiangsu before the date the missive says Prince Shangshan will enter Jiangsu.
findings.rationale: The missive forecasts his entry into Jiangsu on the first; the state should not assert that he can be intercepted there earlier.
findings.replacement: Jin and his party have departed to intercept Prince Shangshan in Jiangsu around the first of next month.

summary: The reading copies and active state are largely consistent, but the packet has a title drift and two actionable timing contradictions.
